appDescription: Chalog records driver-reported vehicle symptoms and available vehicle observations in the background for later service consultation.

function.name: CONTROL_SYMPTOM_RECORD
function.description: Starts a background symptom record or stops collection and saves the record. Requires prior driver consent.

operation.description: Whether to start or stop recording.

note.description: An optional symptom description supplied by the driver when starting.

function.name: ADD_SYMPTOM_EVENT
function.description: Adds a driver symptom description or marks the current moment in the active background record.

note.description: The symptom description supplied by the driver.

markMoment.description: Whether to mark the current symptom moment.

function.name: OPEN_CHAROK_RECORDS
function.description: Opens the Chalog panel to view the current or saved record without starting recording.
